trechos: For Part I and Part II, the study duration will be approximately 37 weeks (3 weeks Screening, 8 weeks Run-in, 24 weeks Treatment, 2 weeks Safety follow-up).
trechosPt: Para a Parte I e a Parte II, a duração do estudo será de aproximadamente 37 semanas (3 semanas de triagem, 8 semanas de run-in, 24 semanas de tratamento, 2 semanas de acompanhamento de segurança).

tituloPt: Comparação de insulina Tregopil (IN-105) com insulina Aspart em pacientes com diabetes mellitus tipo 2

titulo: Effect of Dosing Time and Meal on IN-105 (Insulin Tregopil) PK and PD

braco.texto:
Cohort1: Treatments A, B, and C: IN-105 administered at 30, 20 or 10 minutes before the ADA meal, respectively; Treatment D: Placebo administered at 20 minutes before the ADA meal.

Cohort 2: Treatments A, B, and C: IN-105 administered at 4, 5, and 6 hours after the previous ADA meal, respectively; Treatments D, E, and F: Placebo administered at 4, 5, and 6 hours after the previous ADA meal, respectively.
